notes.title: Quality of life patches and little improvements!
notes.content:
[b][h1]Hey everyone!

Today we pushed out a little update where the following changes were made:[/h1][/b]

[b]- Added a sound when the player takes damage
- Added a passed or defeated screen at the end of each mode so there is less confusion for new players once the level ends
- Added a highscore tracker for the infinite mode so you can keep track of your best score in the infinite level[/b]


[h1][b]Thanks for reading and I wish you a great day! [/b][/h1]
